pages.text: $(thing)Cozy Cafe$() lets you open a small restaurant. Customers spawn at a sign, order from your menu, and leave tips and dirty plates. Menu items are foods and drinks; the menu screen says if one can't be added.

pages.title: Cafe Manager
pages.text: The heart of the cafe. Place Cafe Menus in its working area and link a Cafe Sign before opening. You can rename the cafe, view stats and see reputation grow.

pages.title: Cafe Sign
pages.text: Marks where customers appear. Sneak and right-click the Manager to link it before placing the sign.

pages.title: Plating Station
pages.text: Used for mains. Right-click with a Serving Plate, then with a menu item, then with an empty hand to take the plated dish.

Dirty serving plates drop after customers leave. Hold use on a sponge or sink to clean them. The $(item)Cafe Catalog$() in your offhand shows menu price and decor info in tooltips.$(br2)Themed decor sets a theme and modifiers (tips, patience, price). Food: $(l:food/sweets_and_drinks)Sweets and Drinks$(/l).
